task.title: Fetch and cache league seasons and history
task.description:
## Why
This is the biggest saving in the system. An uncached league costs about 40 seconds and a couple of hundred Sleeper calls. A cached one costs about 37 calls and 3 seconds.

## Steps
1. Port `fetch_season` and `walk_lineage` from `rebuild/crawl.py`, storing each league season as one object in R2.
2. Never re-fetch a completed season.
3. Reuse the current season's copy until the NFL week moves on or the copy is older than a set age. Start at 30 minutes.
4. Make two requests for the same league at the same time share one pull instead of fetching twice.
5. Store league data once per league so any team's report can be built from it.

## Done when
- A second report for the same league, for any team, makes no calls for completed seasons.
- Two simultaneous requests for one uncached league cause one set of Sleeper calls.
